classification: Conditional retrospective simulation; feed, historical forecast vintages and fills are not verified

assumptions.timings: Quote until qualifying start, resume three hours after scheduled qualifying after a fresh book, pause at UTC midnight, resume at race start minus 3h after a fresh snapshot, and stop quoting 30 minutes before the race.
assumptions.holding: At wind-down, retain a net position if its model forecast advantage over its weighted average entry price exceeds the specified per-share margin. Otherwise attempt to close; residual positions with insufficient displayed liquidity are explicitly forced to settle. This entry-price rule does not compare the position with the current market opportunity; settlement depends on the winner.
assumptions.sourceSelection: Pre-qualifying tape is used only when a qualifying-post capture and matching post-qualifying roster entry exist; a market can enter with qualifying-post data alone or race-day data alone. These retrospective completeness and roster rules are not ex-ante selection rules.
assumptions.model: Projected pairwise finishing-order forecasts are not calibrated winner probabilities; qualifying positions proxy the grid and historical publication/revision times are unverified.
assumptions.qualifyingPublication: F1 qualifying reports were published before the three-hour restart in both races; exact historical availability and revisions of all qualifying inputs remain unverified. This extended window was added after inspecting earlier results.
assumptions.clock: For source timestamps leading receipt by at most 5ms, effective receipt is delayed to the source timestamp and events are reordered; larger leads are rejected. Actual collector and venue clock synchronization is not verified.
assumptions.delayedPrints: Markets with recorded trade receipt more than one second after source time are excluded. Smaller delays may still overlap cancellations; historical fills and acknowledgment timing remain unverified.
assumptions.weekendInformation: Pre-qualifying probabilities use previous races only; practice and any current-weekend sprint are not model inputs.
assumptions.fees: 0.03 taker fee coefficient before 10 July 2026 and 0.05 afterward, with zero maker fee; contract-specific fees and gas are unverified.
assumptions.outcomes: Recorded resolution is used for realized settlement and a metadata integrity check only. One winning driver per event; Other and uniform-half void scenarios are included.
